subject: Pilot success blueprint and measurable acceptance probes — Novacare MAP
messages:
From: Evan Mills <evan.mills@novacare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot exploration — next steps and requirements

Jordan —

Thanks for the kickoff last week. Our execs asked me to capture a short, measurable set of acceptance probes for the pilot so we can decide quickly whether to accelerate to a paid deployment. Attached is our high-level POC requirements doc (novacare-poc-requirements.pdf).

Top priorities for the MAP from our side:
- Quality: end-to-end precision/recall measured against our annotated test set (we can provide 1,200 labeled examples).
- Latency: 95th percentile token-generation < 250ms for 2k token windows on our sample workload.
- Reliability: sustained 10k requests/day without >1% error rate.
- Data handling: KMS keys and audit logs for all requests.

If you can put together a short MAP that maps each priority to an acceptance test, responsible owner, and the evidence we should capture, that would let our procurement and security teams move in parallel. Ideal timeline: run tests the week of July 8, and a close decision by July 20 to meet our Q3 rollout plan.

Evan
CTO, Novacare Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Mills <evan.mills@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Lydia Park <lpark@novacare.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot exploration — next steps and requirements

Hi Evan —

Appreciate the clarity. Draft MAP below (high level) — I put owners next to each acceptance probe and a suggested evidence artifact. I also linked a living doc where we can iterate: https://drive.google.com/novacare/pilot-map-draft

1) Accuracy baseline (owner: Soojin)
   - Acceptance probe: end-to-end F1 >= 0.82 on Novacare labeled set
   - Evidence: evaluation report + confusion matrix + sample pass/fail vignettes

2) Latency SLA (owner: Platform team / Ben)
   - Acceptance probe: 95p gen latency < 250ms for 2k windows (measured over 24h live replay)
   - Evidence: tracing export, token-level latency histogram, infra-utilization snapshot

3) Throughput & stability (owner: Ben)
   - Acceptance probe: 10k requests/day sustained for 3 consecutive days with errored requests < 1%
   - Evidence: production-like load run report, error-rate dashboard snapshot

4) Security & auditability (owner: Jordan)
   - Acceptance probe: KMS integration validated, audit logs for all calls available for 30 days
   - Evidence: audit log sample, KMS rotation proof, SOC2 artifact pointers

5) Roll-forward safety checks (owner: Soojin)
   - Acceptance probe: manual QA on 50 flagged edge cases; automatic fallback to baseline model on regressions
   - Evidence: QA checklist + rollback playbook

Proposed exit gates:
- Green: all probes met and evidence uploaded -> Procurement issues PO and we schedule cutover
- Yellow: one non-critical probe missed -> scoped remediation + second verification run within 7 business days
- Red: critical probe (accuracy/latency/security) missed -> pause and exec review

Next steps I propose: 1) Ben to book the witness load run (target week of July 8), 2) Soojin to ingest Novacare labeled set and run initial evaluation by June 25, 3) I’ll confirm KMS and audit logging steps with your security lead.

Can Ben and Soojin confirm timeline ownership? I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and a versioned MAP spreadsheet (I’ll attach the acceptance workbook once we agree).

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Mills <evan.mills@novacare.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Lydia Park <lpark@novacare.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot exploration — next steps and requirements

On Tue, Jun 11, 2028 at 11:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed exit gates:
> - Green: all probes met and evidence uploaded -> Procurement issues PO and we schedule cutover
> - Yellow: one non-critical probe missed -> scoped remediation + second verification run within 7 business days
> - Red: critical probe (accuracy/latency/security) missed -> pause and exec review

Adding procurement constraints from our side: Novacare’s PO needs to be inside a two-week window from the green signal to hold pricing and reserved capacity guarantees. Lydia — can you confirm if that calendar is feasible?

I’ve scheduled a witness load run placeholder for July 9-11 (internal calendar invite sent). For the load run we’ll need:
- A 24-hour replay file (we can accept streaming or batched logs)
- Expected concurrency profile (peak RPS, typical RPS)
- A primary contact at Novacare for gating the run (so we can coordinate traffic cutover)

DocuSign link for our standard MSA so procurement can start parallel reviews: https://www.docusign.com/preview/MA-2028-0093

I’ll attach an initial acceptance workbook (novacare-eval-acceptance.xlsx) after Jordan confirms the probe list; that workbook will include the exact measurement queries we’ll run and the evidence checklist.

—
Ben Carter
Principal SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Mills <evan.mills@novacare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Lydia Park <lpark@novacare.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot exploration — next steps and requirements

Jordan / team —

This draft MAP looks good and addresses the board’s main asks. Two small requests before we call it final:
1) Latency probe — please add a separate earth-mover metric for 99p latency and a nominal degradation allowance when running under sustained high-concurrency (we expect peak spikes during business hours).
2) Evidence retention — can Redwood retain audit logs for 90 days during the pilot (we can negotiate longer term in the PO)?

Assuming those tweaks, we will:
- Confirm witness-run window (July 9-11)
- Start internal security questionnaire review in parallel (I’ll have that complete by June 22)
- Aim to have procurement sign-off no later than July 20 pending green signal

Lydia — I’ve looped you for procurement timeline confirmation. Ben — please keep the DocuSign flow open so we can iterate.

Thanks — looking forward to a crisp MAP and a fast verification run.

Evan
CTO, Novacare Health
